_comment: Tier-2 Layer-D: cross-backend numerical-consistency suite. Closes task #34. The Layer-C anchors (commits c84122e, 7973e80, 95c7f2b, 09e7239, etc.) verify each backend's catalog API converges to its own L2 error against the manufactured solution. Layer-D goes one step further: the SAME MMS produces NUMERICALLY CONSISTENT solutions across DIFFERENT backends. Single fixture runs both skfem (high-level forms + condense + solve) AND a manual scipy-P1 assembly (matches the kratos catalog scipy pattern) for poisson MMS u=sin(πx)·sin(πy) on [0,1]². Asserts pointwise max diff <= 5e-3 between skfem vs manual-scipy at 9 interior eval points AND each backend vs the analytic exact. Catches the class of bug that breaks one backend's catalog without breaking another (sign-convention errors, wrong material laws, off-by-one quadrature) — these would silently slip through individual Layer-C gates. Verified on 2026-06-01: skfem<>scipy max diff = 5.36e-4, both within 1.3e-3 of analytic exact. Filed under kratos / auxiliary_overview / pitfall_index=101 for runner-routing; the fixture is backend-agnostic but routes through repo .venv via the kratos slot to access the full MCP stack. MUTATION CONTROL (T2_MUTATE=1, re-runnable) - a POSITIVE control. The scipy arm's manufactured source drops to pi^2 from 2*pi^2; max_skfem_minus_scipy goes 5.3598e-04 -> 4.9987e-01 and the forbidden 'FAIL:' appears. Proved KILLED 2026-08-07. WORTH KNOWING WHERE THE POWER SITS: three of the four expectations - max_skfem_minus_scipy=, max_skfem_minus_exact=, max_scipy_minus_exact= - are bare key prefixes that match ANY value, nan and 1e+30 included, and all three still MATCHED in the mutated run. The fourth, poisson_eval_pts_count=9, pins a property of the fixture's own input rather than of either solve. The entire numerical claim therefore rests on the forbidden 'FAIL:' token.

_mutation.note: POSITIVE control: the fixture asserts AGREEMENT between two independent assemblies, so there is nothing in it to take away. The mutation injects into the scipy arm exactly the bug class its own docstring names - a wrong manufactured source term, pi^2 instead of 2*pi^2, which is what dropping one of the two second derivatives of sin(pi x) sin(pi y) produces. The scipy solution loses half its amplitude, max_skfem_minus_scipy goes from 5.4e-04 to 5.0e-01 and the forbidden 'FAIL:' appears.
